The README's licensing paragraph links "Additional information about the license model can be found in the [docs](https://docs.n8n.io/sustainable-use-license/)" — that docs page was removed and now returns HTTP 404, so anyone wanting to understand the license model hits a dead end.

Cause: n8n's docs site restructured its license content; the Sustainable Use License explanation now lives on the Community license page.

Fix: point the link at the current page, https://docs.n8n.io/n8n-community-license (verified HTTP 200; its "What is the Sustainable Use License?" section is the same content the old link promised).

Evidence:
- Before: `curl -sL https://docs.n8n.io/sustainable-use-license/` -> HTTP 404
- After: `curl -sL https://docs.n8n.io/n8n-community-license` -> HTTP 200

Single focused change, README only.
